steps.label: Pull & Positioning
steps.note:
Phase 2 here: https://ff14.toolboxgaming.space/?id=562530446784261&preview=1

Raid Guide and Waymarker Preset by Clees: https://www.icy-veins.com/ffxiv/the-weapons-refrain-ultimate-guides-hub

MT Pull her into the center and point her north to get ready for Slipstream. DPS stay south. OT and healers east to be ready for Mistral Song.

steps.label: Slipstream
steps.note: Main Tank dodge cleave

steps.label: Mistral Song
steps.note:
Healer gets marked. 
OT stands in front with mitigation.

steps.label: Move to D
steps.note:
Cyclone drops on the OT.
Move out of the Cyclone and to D.

steps.label: Adds 1 - Plumes
steps.note:
4 Satin Plumes spawn, tethering to random DPS. and 1 Spiny Plume spawns and tethers to a random person, OT needs to hit it with ranged to gain aggro/enmity/tether, and take it west of D.

Voke and reprisal also works for taking the tether. Dps will need to hold off on AOEs until plumes move in and OT gets a damaging attack in.

steps.label: Position and AoE Down
steps.note:
Gather all Plumes at D and AOE DPS them down. Should kill all or most of them before Garuda Shrieks for Feather Rain.

Allow the Satin Plume to deal 2 mini tank busters (Cyclone) on OT before killing, allowing OT to gain 2 stacks of Thermal Low.

steps.label: Slipstream
steps.note: Sidestep buster on MT

steps.label: Downburst
steps.note: Immediately following slipstream, heavy physical tankbuster that cleaves. MT mitigate and takes this alone. Once taken, MT helps aoe the plumes.

steps.label: Feather Rain
steps.note: Garuda will jump in the air, and spawn multiple small circle AoEs under players. Move back around the center as a group.

steps.label: Gigastorm (Bubble)
steps.note:
Once the Spiny Plume dies it will spawn an AOE marker around it that turns into a shield bubble that mitigates wind attacks. 

When entering this bubble with Thermal Low stacks, they will be cleansed and raid-wide damage will be taken by the party depending on how many stacks entered the bubble.

steps.label: Mistral Shriek
steps.note:
Raid-wide AOE. All but OT step into bubble to mitigate this damage.

There's a good chance this will happen before the bubble is down, just heal the extra if necessary.

steps.label: Aetherically Charged 1 - OT Cleanse
steps.note:
OT will step into the bubble, cleansing their 2 stacks of Thermal Low, giving Garuda her first Aetherical Charge. 

It is recommended to wait until party is topped off or sufficiently healed because cleansing 2 stacks of Thermal Low will inflict 30,000-40,000 damage to each player.

steps.label: Friction One
steps.note:
Garuda will face a random player and hit them with small splash AoE dealing magic damage. Inflicts a stack of Thermal Low to all players hit outside the bubble.

3 pre-assigned DPS (OT and 2 Melee) will exit the bubble while Friction 1 is cast. Stay near the group, but outside the bubble so that all players can get hit by Friction.

steps.label: Friction One
steps.note: At the end of Friction 1, the three pre-assigned players should have 1 stack of Thermal Low, and all other players should have none.

steps.label: Friction Two
steps.note: All players exit the bubble to take friction 2. Make sure to stack so all players receive a stack of Thermal Low.

steps.label: Friction Two
steps.note: At the end of Friction 2, the three pre-assigned players should have 2 stacks of Thermal Low, and all other players should have 1 stack.

steps.label: Aetherically Charged 2 - DPS1 Cleanse
steps.note:
DPS 1 will step into the bubble, cleansing their 2 stacks of Thermal Low, giving Garuda her second Aetherical Charge. 

Wait until party is topped off or sufficiently healed.

steps.label: Aetherically Charged 3 - DPS 2 Cleanse
steps.note:
DPS 2 will step into the bubble, cleansing their 2 stacks of Thermal Low, giving Garuda her third Aetherical Charge. 

Wait until party is topped off or sufficiently healed.

If the bubble disappears before you can get the 2nd cleanse in, consider holding dps and killing the spiny plume later. As long as OT doesn't get a 3rd stack, you can hold it for a considerable time to give the party much more leeway.

steps.label: Feather Rain
steps.note: Garuda will jump, indicating Feather Rain. Move as a group to avoid puddles.

steps.label: Aerial Blast
steps.note:
Raid buster dealing massive magical damage to all players.

Stack middle for heals.

steps.label: Garuda Sisters Appear
steps.note: Garuda summons Chirada and Suparna (aka Sisters), untargettable adds.

steps.label: Feather Rain
steps.note: Watch for jump. Spread to avoid puddles.

steps.label: Position
steps.note:
MT should keep garuda centered here.

If your DC or group prefers to pull her out, keep her at the edge of the upcoming AOE where A marker has been moved.

Sisters will spawn at 2 of any 4 Cardinal Directions. This is the earliest you can spot their positions.

steps.label: Eye of the Storm & Wicked Wheel
steps.note:
Starting from North, MT takes the first sister going clockwise, and OT taking the first sister going counter-clockwise.

Everybody else stack SE.

steps.label: Mistral Song x2
steps.note: Sisters will hit the party with 2 individual Mistral Songs, mitigated by the Tanks.

steps.label: Cyclones Appear + Bait
steps.note:
Cyclones will spawn where the first person (Tanks) was hit with Mistral Song.

These won't do damage until after feather rain. Melee can move back in, stay on the cardinal sides to bait feather rain. Ranged stay stacked.

steps.label: Feather Rain
steps.note: Dodge feather rains while moving out and away from the cyclones.

steps.label: Adds 2 - Plumes Again
steps.note:
Garuda will use another Eye of the Storm and summon 4 Satin Plumes. Bring them to 1 (center) and AOE them down.

Tank bring Garuda to the center and face her North. Party stay behind her while taking care of adds.

steps.label: Mesohigh Tethers
steps.note: While AOE-ing down the Satin Plumes, Chirada and Suparna will appear at East and West and tether random players with Mesohigh. Beat down the plumes in the center while designated players take tethers.

steps.label: Awaken
steps.note: Tether can be taken by running through them. The DPS with 1 stack of Thermal Low will go to D, while the OT with 2 stacks will go to B, both will take Mesohigh, heavy magic damage. This will cleanse their stacks and give Garuda her fourth Aetherical Charge, AWAKENING HER.

steps.label: Awoken Downburst
steps.note: Garuda's Awoken Downburst will be executed during Mesohigh Tethers and can be taken alone by MT (remember no cast) with at least 2 mitigations and shields and heals.

steps.label: Feather Rain
steps.note: Dodge puddles while pulling her north. Party stay behind Garuda.

steps.label: Slipstream
steps.note:
2.5s cast time, MT dodge.

Should be able to kill Garuda by this time in the current expansion (5.XX)

Final Slipstream and then Enrage

If this phase was done correctly, you should be defeating Garuda with 4 players having 1 stack of Thermal Low (1 tank, 1 dps (pref. ranged) and 2 healers), of which 3 you will need in later phases of the Ultima Weapon. After defeating Garuda when she is Woken, a light puddle will appear where she is defeated. Make sure either a healer, caster, or melee picks up this puddle.

steps.label: Wicked Wheel
steps.note:
Small circle AoE dealing lethal physical damage to all players in melee range.

Make sure to avoid the wheel first, and then move into melee range as soon as the marker disappears, as Wicked Tornado (next) has no cast time.

steps.label: Wicked Tornado
steps.note: This can be outranged if necessary.

steps.label: Awoken Downburst 2
steps.note: Soak as group

steps.label: Slipstream - > Enrage (2:55)
steps.note: Final Slipstream and then Enrage

steps.label: Puddle
steps.note:
Have a Healer, Caster, or Melee grab the puddle, and stack mid for phase 2.

Standard order is Healer (Garuda) → Caster (Ifrit) → Melee (Titan)
